headline: Xiaomi's SkyNomad SUV Challenges Western Brands at Half the Price
summary: Xiaomi Auto's new SkyNomad N70 offers advanced technology and luxury features comparable to Range Rover, but at a significantly lower price point, aiming to disrupt the global SUV market.
details: Xiaomi has unveiled its SkyNomad SUVs, with the N70 model set to challenge established Western automotive brands. This five-seat, extended-range EV boasts technology superior to a Range Rover Velar while retailing at approximately half the price, signaling a major disruption in the lucrative SUV segment.

The SkyNomad N70, particularly in its 'Stealth Black Edition,' bears a striking resemblance to the Range Rover, aiming to capture market share with a blend of luxury and advanced features. The larger N90 model offers seven seats and a 'Max Studio' camper version with a pop-up roof, transforming the second row into a bed in just 30 seconds.

Inside, the SkyNomad features a reconfigurable interior on its Kunlun platform, allowing seats to slide and the front seats to swivel 180 degrees. Optional features include floor-mounted tables for 'living-room-style' layouts and a moving center console. The N90 Max Studio adds a sleeping loft, projector, and screen.

Further enhancing its appeal, Xiaomi is offering an optional in-brand car-to-car communication system that utilizes cellular networks for 'unlimited range,' a feature inspired by technology found in its smartphones. This level of innovation aims to surpass the interior amenities typically found in flagship models from Western manufacturers.

The automotive industry sees SUVs as a dominant force, accounting for nearly half of all new vehicle sales globally. Chinese manufacturers are increasingly focusing on this segment to appeal to Western markets, with brands like Jaecoo already seeing significant success in the UK. Xiaomi is poised to enter the European market in 2027, building on the rapid success of its first EV, the SU7 Ultra, which claimed the title of 'World's Fastest Sedan' in 2024.
